title: Exceptional half of proper pushforward to an identity leg
statement:
Fix the global finite-field datum and the finite coefficient conventions of [def-trf-coefficient-conventions], with $A=A_{E,n}$ and $s=\operatorname{Spec}k$. Let $a:X\to Y$ and $d:C\to X$ be separated finite-type morphisms of separated finite-type $k$-schemes [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], with $a$ and $q=a\circ d$ proper [def-weil-proper-morphism]. Let $K\in D^b_{ctf}(X,A)$ and assume the constructible exceptional adjunctions of [def-trf-admissibility] for $d$ and $\operatorname{id}_Y$. Assume $Rd^!K\in D^b_{ctf}(C,A)$ and $K'=Ra_*K\in D^b_{ctf}(Y,A)$; retain bounded-below etale-origin witnesses [def-sf-etale-origin-subcategory] for the displayed inputs to compact-support composition. Write $j_h:Rh_*\xrightarrow{\sim}Rh_!$ for inverse proper coincidence when $h=a,q$, as in [prop-functor-package], and $\alpha_{v,w}:Rv_!Rw_!\xrightarrow{\sim}R(vw)_!$ for the canonical composition isomorphisms of [thm-sf-comp-composition]. Write $\varepsilon_d:Rd_!Rd^!K\to K$ for the exceptional counit.

Let $\delta:Rq_*Rd^!K\to R(\operatorname{id}_Y)^!K'$ be the exceptional half for the leg diagram $\operatorname{id}_Y\circ q=a\circ d$ of [def-trf-coefficient-pushforward]: it is the $R(\operatorname{id}_Y)_!\dashv R(\operatorname{id}_Y)^!$ transpose of the compact-support composition comparison for this equality followed by $Ra_!\varepsilon_d$, with proper coincidence for $a,q$. Identify $R(\operatorname{id}_Y)_!$ with the identity by the canonical identity comparison, and write $\epsilon_{\mathrm{id},K'}:R(\operatorname{id}_Y)^!K'\xrightarrow{\sim}K'$ for the exceptional counit under that identification. Then
$$
\epsilon_{\mathrm{id},K'}\circ\delta
=j_{a,K}^{-1}\circ Ra_!(\varepsilon_d)\circ\alpha_{a,d,Rd^!K}^{-1}\circ j_{q,Rd^!K}:
Rq_*Rd^!K\longrightarrow Ra_*K.
$$

source.place: Proof, The pushed coefficient map is the global operator: exceptional half for b_1 = identity, inverse composition followed by counit

proof.text:
Specialize the exceptional-leg construction of [def-trf-coefficient-pushforward] to $f=a$, $g=q$, $b_1=\operatorname{id}_Y$, $c_1=d$, so $b_1g=q=ad$. Put $M=Rd^!K$, $L=R(\operatorname{id}_Y)_!$ and let $t:L\xrightarrow{\sim}\operatorname{id}$ be the canonical identity comparison. The map whose transpose defines $\delta$ is $\beta:LRq_*M\to K'=Ra_*K$. Proper coincidence in clause (3) of [prop-functor-package] and composition in [thm-sf-comp-composition] give it explicitly as
$$\beta=j_{a,K}^{-1}\circ Ra_!(\varepsilon_d)\circ\alpha_{a,d,M}^{-1}\circ\alpha_{\operatorname{id}_Y,q,M}\circ L(j_{q,M}).$$
The finite coefficient ring has $\ell$ invertible in $k$; all maps are separated finite type. The retained bounded-below etale-origin witnesses [def-sf-etale-origin-subcategory] put $M$ in the domain of composition, and that theorem preserves this class. Identity normalization says $\alpha_{\operatorname{id}_Y,q,M}=t_{Rq_!M}$. Naturality of $t$ gives $t_{Rq_!M}\circ L(j_{q,M})=j_{q,M}\circ t_{Rq_*M}$. Consequently $\beta\circ t_{Rq_*M}^{-1}=j_{a,K}^{-1}\circ Ra_!(\varepsilon_d)\circ\alpha_{a,d,M}^{-1}\circ j_{q,M}$.

source.place: Proof, The pushed coefficient map is the global operator: exceptional half for b_1 = identity, inverse composition followed by counit

proof.text:
Use $L\dashv R=R(\operatorname{id}_Y)^!$ from [def-trf-admissibility], with unit $\eta$ and counit $e$. Set $N=Rq_*Rd^!K$. The transpose definition in [def-trf-coefficient-pushforward] is $\delta=R(\beta)\circ\eta_N$. Counit naturality and the triangle identity give
$$e_{K'}\circ L(\delta)=\beta\circ e_{LN}\circ L(\eta_N)=\beta.$$
After the canonical identity comparison $t:L\xrightarrow{\sim}\operatorname{id}$ of [thm-sf-comp-composition], the counit in the statement is $\epsilon_{\mathrm{id},K'}=e_{K'}\circ t_{RK'}^{-1}$. Naturality of $t$ at $\delta:N\to RK'$ therefore gives
$$\epsilon_{\mathrm{id},K'}\circ\delta=e_{K'}\circ L(\delta)\circ t_N^{-1}=\beta\circ t_N^{-1}.$$
Thus inverse transpose is counit followed by the displayed identity identification; all these maps have target $K'=Ra_*K$.

source.place: Proof, the pushed coefficient map is the global operator: exceptional half for b_1 = identity and the adjunction counit

proof.text:
Substitute the expression for $\beta\circ t_N^{-1}$ from Step 1 into the equality in Step 2. This gives
$$\epsilon_{\mathrm{id},K'}\circ\delta=j_{a,K}^{-1}\circ Ra_!(\varepsilon_d)\circ\alpha_{a,d,Rd^!K}^{-1}\circ j_{q,Rd^!K}:Rq_*Rd^!K\longrightarrow Ra_*K,$$
which is the asserted equality. This step is only substitution and reassociation.
